name: Eber
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Shem is the father of all the children of Eber, and Eber is where the name Hebrew comes from.

note.label: Genesis 10: Shem, Ham, Japheth, and Nimrod

points: When he looked on Amalek: that is what you call the Israelis today. Amalek was the first of the nations that fought against us, but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever. The Kenites shall be wasted until Asshur, the Assyrians, carry them away captive; Judges 1:16 tells you about the Kenites. Ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber: write down 1 Maccabees 1:1 and 8:5.

Alas, who shall live when God doeth this! Ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and Chittim is Italy; they shall afflict Asshur and afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever. Eber here is not speaking of Israel, for other peoples besides us came out of Eber, who is of Shem; the history of prophecy opens this up as the prophets are read.

note.label: Numbers 24: A Star out of Jacob and the Latter Days

points: The line runs through Arphaxad, Shelah, and Eber, in whose days the earth was divided, and on through Joktan and his sons.
